description: Compute, for every calendar date between the first and last activity date, the daily active users (DAU) and the rolling 28-day active users: the number of DISTINCT non-internal users active on at least one day in the window [date - 27 days, date]. Dates with no activity must still be emitted (dau = 0) with the correct rolling value. Output columns: activity_date (DATE), dau (INT64), rolling_28d_users (INT64). Sort by activity_date.

activity_date.description: UTC date on which the user was active; may contain duplicate rows

events.description: Number of events in the row

edge_cases: On 2025-06-28 the window still includes 2025-06-01 (28 days inclusive); on 2025-06-29 user 1 drops out
A user active on several days of the window counts once
Dates without any activity (e.g. 2025-06-02) must be present
Internal user 9 is excluded even though it is the only activity on 2025-06-15
common_failure_modes: FM4: COUNT(DISTINCT ...) OVER with an ORDER BY / frame is not supported in BigQuery; summing daily DAU over 28 rows double-counts repeat users
FM2: Window of 28 PRECEDING (29 days) or 27 rows over sparse dates gives off-by-one results
FM3: Using only dates that have activity as the spine omits zero-activity days
